meta.semantics: write-direction evidence for T:FN entities: (A) vfptr installs mov [this+off], offset <vtable VA> — constructor behavior; (B) pure-write this-offset fingerprints AND-matched against flat class layouts (width-agnostic point coverage).

vfptr_channel.method: symbol->VA resolved live from IDA (953/962 offset-install symbols; .omo/agents/mwfp/sym_va{,2}.json); VA -> (class, col_offset) via anchors/rtti_vtable_class.json (binary RTTI truth). this-trace identical to c18v2: entry-ecx undef-since-entry / thiscall arg0 passthrough / <=3 copy hops, label-bounded <=8-instr back-scan (strict) + entry-copy-fullspan fallback.

rules.off==0 & col==0: primary install -> types=[C] (ctor semantics, parity with ctor_types channel)
rules.off==col>0: own-column family install (e.g. ??_7X@@6B@_0 at X's col 4) -> types=[C]+descendants(C)
rules.off>0 & off!=col: embedded standalone base vtable (MI) -> types={D in strict-desc(C) : off in cols(D)} (classes whose RTTI col group actually embeds a C-vtable column at exactly this offset); empty set = member-like install (MT domain) -> skipped, counted

vfptr_channel.guards: per-fn family consistency: all surviving owner classes must sit on one root chain ({s0}+desc(s0)) — factories / multi-primary installs skipped (0 fns, 0 rows). Descendants from anchors/rtti_hierarchy.json full-bases inversion + class_layouts.json parent inversion (transitive).

writes_channel.method: this-traced write accesses (mem-as-dest mov/pop/fst/setcc + arith RMW add/sub/inc/...), distinct offsets >= 2, width ignored (write direction is itself strong). Candidates = classes whose flat layout covers EVERY offset (point coverage, blob members >32B excluded from coverage spans — zero discrimination, c18v2 parity). Size gates: eff_size >= max_off+4 and eff_size <= 6*(max_off+4) (c18v2 parity). NO low-offset guard (task example 0x18|0x1C|0x20 must pass).
writes_channel.guards: dense-exact1 dropped: a sole candidate that is a >=70%-dense class covers nearly anything (c18v2 measured RulesClass absorbing 36/86 fake exacts); multi-candidate rows keep dense members.

meta.mt_dedup: anchors/member_type_installs.json = 329 member-install entries (conf899-audited, 0 column matches, all off!=0 member installs). Site-level overlap with this run's installs counted; emitted rows flagged mt_overlap. The two channels are disjoint by construction: MT types the MEMBER (M:FN:this:0xOFF), this file types the RECEIVER (T:FN).
meta.layouts: class -> {off: width} merged tools/class_layouts.json > anchors/csp_canon_members.json > anchors/member_types.json; inheritance flattened absolute (class_layouts.parent + rtti_base_arrays[1]); declared-size guard against cross-typed receiver pollution (c18v2 parity).
meta.consumption: evidence rows are per-T:FN candidate masks (AND-merge with existing families; heuristic tier like C18/c18v2 — vfptr primary rows are ctor-strength, write rows are layout-strength).
